meaning: onoma-topoeic exclamation and musical sound (as in 哆啦)
conceptZh: 調皮小老鼠踮腳把方盒喇叭與兩塊大彎月起司越疊越高，最後放上一顆小鈴鐺時整座高塔轟然倒塌，精準排成「哆」字並把小老鼠壓在底下只露出得意大眼睛。
object: a square megaphone box and two giant crescent cheese wedges stacked by a cheeky cartoon mouse
morph: A square speaker box and two stacked crescent wedges topple from a swaying tower and lock into the left 口 radical and right stacked 多 component of the Traditional Chinese character 哆.
creativeAngle: 結合「堆疊倒塌（Stack and Topple）」喜劇節奏與「哆」的左右結構（左「口」右「多」的雙夕疊加），讓調皮小老鼠將方形擴音盒與兩塊新月形起司塊高高疊起，最後因一顆小鈴鐺失衡崩塌成標準繁體字「哆」，並在唸出「哆啦」時從字下探出眼睛搖響鈴鐺歡呼，完全原創且避開任何版權角色。
promptEn:
An 8-second 3D animated slapstick literacy clip on a clean, warm cream studio stage with soft daylight and zero background clutter. The lead is an original tiny cheeky cartoon mouse with oversized round ears, a twitching pink nose, and a wide confident grin. 

0.0–1.8s (Want It & Speed-Stack): At center stage, the cheeky cartoon mouse zips back and forth at lightning speed, piling up giant bright-cobalt props into a precarious tower: first a chunky square megaphone box at the base, then two oversized crescent-shaped wedges balanced tip-to-tip on top. As the first off-screen utterance "哆 (ㄉㄨㄛ)" is spoken, the mouse scrambles to the summit with a tiny golden jingle bell in its paws, grinning wildly.

1.8–3.5s (Try & Swaying Miss): Standing on trembling tiptoes atop the upper crescent wedge, the mouse reaches out to crown the stack with the tiny bell. The tower sways left with a cartoon rubbery creak, then lurches far to the right as the mouse windmills its tail frantically to keep balance. With a cheeky wink, it drops the tiny bell delicately onto the very peak—and freezes for a split-second beat of total silence.

3.5–5.0s (The Big Topple & Glyph Lock): BONK! The tiny bell tips the balance and the entire stack collapses in a joyful cartoon heap with squash-and-stretch bounce. As the second utterance "哆 (ㄉㄨㄛ)" rings out, the pieces tumble and lock cleanly into the single centered Traditional Chinese character "哆" in solid, saturated cobalt blue filling 70% of the frame height: the square megaphone box settles on the left as the "口" radical, while the two crescent wedges stack neatly on the right as the upper and lower "夕" components of "多". The mouse is buried harmlessly beneath the bottom right corner with only its big blinking eyes and round ears poking out.

5.0–8.0s (3-Second Hold & Payoff): The cobalt-blue glyph "哆" holds completely still, crisp, centered, and uncropped against the light cream background for the final 3 full seconds. Right as the voice speaks the word "哆啦 (ㄉㄨㄛ ㄌㄚ)", the buried mouse pops one paw out from beside the glyph, shakes the golden bell in a triumphant "ta-da!" fanfare that releases two small golden musical notes into the air, and flashes a dizzy, victorious grin without touching or blocking any stroke.

Audio: A warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads slowly and distinctly with exact standard tones: "哆、哆、哆啦" (ㄉㄨㄛ、ㄉㄨㄛ、ㄉㄨㄛ ㄌㄚ). First "哆 (ㄉㄨㄛ)" as the mouse climbs the stack, second "哆 (ㄉㄨㄛ)" as the toppled pieces lock into the glyph, and "哆啦 (ㄉㄨㄛ ㄌㄚ)" as the mouse rings the bell in celebration during the final hold. Soft cartoon boing and chime sound effects only; no on-screen vocabulary text, subtitles, or watermarks.
